items.question: Which method best helps you learn about natural resources?
options: Observe or use evidence, connect it to the concept, and explain the conclusion.

items.question: Explain natural resources and give one everyday example.
items.answer: A strong answer gives an accurate explanation and a relevant example.

items.question: Apply natural resources to a new everyday situation. What would you observe or use as evidence?

flashcards.back: Define natural resources, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define biodiversity, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define resource conservation, give an example, and explain why it matters.

interactive_activities.title: Explore natural resources
interactive_activities.instructions: Use a safe, age-appropriate task specifically focused on natural resources. Record what you notice, explain it, and state what you learned.

interactive_activities.title: Use it in a new situation
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where biodiversity is useful and explain your reasoning.

interactive_activities.title: Teach it back
interactive_activities.instructions: Teach sustainable use to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps.
